info.title: Variety Groceries production API
info.description: Implemented production subset: identity, catalogue, Product Media upload/review plus queued image-generation authority, inventory receiving, delivery configuration, authoritative checkout/orders, provider-neutral Payments Authority, provider-neutral Refunds Authority, Fulfilment + Stock Handover Authority, Dispatch + Rider Authority, Logistics L1 network/workflow/route configuration plus L2 Shipment Execution authority, and PostgreSQL-backed Storefront CMS draft/publish authority. L2 records server-owned shipment planning and movement evidence. L3 adds a read-only customer-safe route journey to the existing secured PublicOrder response; courier-provider connectivity and notification delivery remain closed. COD cash collection/remittance, physical returns/restocking, POS cash authority, live courier providers, GPS/ETA/route optimization, external email/SMS/WhatsApp notification delivery and complete public storefront cutover remain closed. Customer-only in-app inbox authority is phase 1 of L4.
